instruction: I am planning to buy a few things on amazon for my company's camping trip next week. I have drafted an email to my manager listing the items for confirmation, but the draft is missing individual prices. Please update them in the TODO placeholders and send the email.
notes: Flow: get passwords, log into Gmail, locate the camping-trip draft (show_drafts with query), read its body (show_draft) to learn the line items ('- <qty> X <name> => TODO'), look up each product's price on Amazon via search_products (no login needed), update the draft body with the prices, then send the draft (send_email_from_draft deletes the draft and creates the Email/thread records, matching the expected DB changes; the recipient is the manager, already set in the draft). The number of line items is unknown a priori; the model assumes 4 items (item-1..item-4) and uses a discrete counter (c0..c4 with succ/num-items) so update_draft is only allowed once every item's price has been found; adjust item/count objects if the draft has a different number of lines. Price lines are filled with quantity x unit price (total per line); amazon.show_product could optionally be used after each search to confirm the price but is not required.
